title: Gate Prix
tagline: Kart racing through a dilution fridge: steer through the right gates to build a quantum circuit.
description: A behind-the-car kart racer for 1 or 2 players against computer racers (EASY, TOUGH or BRUTAL). Gate arches stand across the track: drive through the glowing one in each row to build the target quantum circuit, gate by gate. Every right gate is a boost, and the CIRCUIT CHECK before the final lap turns a better circuit into a faster warp. Item boxes give you MEASURE, TUNNEL, SPLIT, QEC and DECOHERENCE to use on the way.

keyboard.p1: A / D to steer, S to brake (S + steer drifts), B to use your item, Space to pause
keyboard.p2: Left / Right to steer, Down to brake (Down + steer drifts), L to use your item, Enter to pause

how_to_play: Your kart accelerates by itself: steer it through the glowing gate in every row.
Each right gate adds to your circuit and gives you a boost; a wrong one breaks your streak.
Before the final lap the CIRCUIT CHECK compares your circuit with the target: the more right, the bigger the warp.
Pull back and steer to drift; let go for a mini-turbo. A uses the item a box gave you.
Start (Space or Enter) pauses the game.
